blocks.text: Ruffa Gutierrez stressed that her mom Annabelle Rama is alive and well after the latter became a subject of a recent death hoax. Gutierrez issued a statement through her Facebook page on Monday, Oct. 19, while calling on content creators to use their platforms responsibly. “To all content creators, I sincerely hope we can use our platforms to spread truth, kindness, and positivity rather than misinformation and hate,” the actress said. “Spreading false stories and damaging someone’s reputation for the sake of views and engagement is never right.” “Walang katotohanan ang mga kumakalat na balita.
